title: Publish exact CCP2 qualification disposition matrix
description:
Scope: configuration-specific qualification tables in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md or a focused linked qualification document under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ if needed. Consume authority.12 postmeasurement authorization disposition, rf.12 qualification disposition and admission.14 software evidence. Associate exact board/radio/module/antenna/firmware/plan/profile tuples with source-backed authority, raw RF artifacts and reproducible software results. Record no-go and unassessed variants. Do not perform measurements, seek approvals, file externally or make a new legal determination.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use concrete authority.12, rf.12 and admission.14 dependencies only; do not depend on their rollup parents or optional authority.13 filings. Prefer extending the existing conformance guide over another inventory framework.
acceptance_criteria: Each configuration row names exact component/revision identifiers, operating basis, applicable restrictions, evidence artifacts and pass/fail/not-assessed class. RF and authorization dispositions are copied accurately from their owning leaves, including limitations and unresolved conditions. Source/waveform/configuration changes identify affected evidence requiring re-review. A channel count, FCC logo, compile or software pass never substitutes for grant/measurement evidence. Optional external filing completion is not an unconditional prerequisite to documenting a no-go or unassessed disposition.
